about: A turn the server sent away from a held Claude login, whose fallback cannot start on this computer. runner-rs/src/execute.rs drives it and checks it sends exactly these events and completion fields; backend/tests/test_login_holds.py replays them against the server.

payload.text: claude login held (usage limit) until 02:40 UTC; running this turn on acme-missing
RuntimeError: fallback harness interrupted; inspect local runner
